test_title: PYST 76: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Get a second wind

options.text: Have less energy and be extremely tired
Have renewed energy after having been tired

solution: The correct answer is **'Have renewed energy after having been tired.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "Get a second wind" is an idiom that means to find new strength or energy to continue something that is an effort. (कुछ को जारी रखने के लिए नई शक्ति या ऊर्जा का पता लगाना, जो एक प्रयास है।) • Example Sentence: I was so tired in the middle of the marathon, but then I got a second wind and was able to finish the race. **Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Have less energy and be extremely tired: To be fatigued or worn out. (थकान ) • Having less energy after resting: To feel drained or less energetic after a period of rest or relaxation. (आराम या विश्राम की अवधि के बाद खत्म होने या कम ऊर्जावान महसूस करना।) • Have two different choices: To have two different options or possibilities from which to choose. (दो विभिन्न विकल्प या संभावनाएँ होनी चाहिए जिनमें से चुनना है।) 3b:Tc52, The correct answer is "**miss**".
